title: Wave Riding
tagline: Carve the face. Beat the foam.
description: The ocean tradition of riding waves. Paddle in, pop up and carve up and down the face of the wave with one thumb, pump speed, ride the tube, launch off the lip and stay ahead of the foam on four beaches from dawn to storm. Surf sessions, a daily break, free ride and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Tap to paddle, then tap inside the green ring to pop up.
Drag up and down anywhere to carve the face of the wave.
Carving builds speed: keep moving to stay ahead of the foam.
Follow the glints for a combo, sit low in a tube, flick to spin in the air.
Three waves make a session; use Think when you want a hint.
